rows.b: A specialized computer that forwards data packets between networks at wire speed. It is the reason your messages find their way.
A chip of artificial neurons that sips power sits beside a regular processor that handles exact math. Senses go to the neurons; spreadsheets go to the CPU.
Hundreds of neutral atoms are held in place by focused laser beams like tweezers, then excited to giant Rydberg states to interact. The array can rearrange itself for each problem.
The first machines to run real quantum algorithms used the atomic nuclei inside liquid molecules, read by the same physics as hospital MRI scanners. A famous factoring demo ran on seven qubits.
